newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson eases, then recovers on result.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson eases, then recovers on result.

text.p: Shares in Swedish telecommunications company L.M. Ericsson fell by one crown after the company announced nine month profits that matched analysts' expectations.

The share, after several days' gains, fell four crowns to 184.5 shortly before the results were announced at 0900 GMT. The share then fell one crown to 183.5, touching a low of 183, before recovering to the pre-announcement level of 184.5.
Ericsson posted a nine-month profit of 6.258 billion crowns, exactly in line with expectations.
